Health officials and politicians call for urgent action to prevent illness among patients, children, and the elderly.

summary: Seven cases of type‑2 diabetes have been recorded in girls aged 5‑9 in England and Wales, with a further 146 cases in girls 10‑14 and 64 in boys of the same age group. The condition, traditionally seen in adults, is rapidly progressing in children and can cause serious eye, kidney, and heart damage early on. Rising obesity, sugary diets and lack of exercise are blamed for the surge, while care for young patients varies widely.

Seven girls in England and Wales aged five to nine developing diabetes .

summary:
Florida authorities released body‑cam footage of an August 2014 raid that killed Corey Tanner, a 24‑year‑old serial offender, inside his home.  
Marshals and sheriff’s deputies surrounded the house, demanded Tanner surrender with his hands up, and let four children exit while he stayed inside.  
The footage shows officers circling the house and the fatal shots being fired, but the exact moment of the shooting is omitted.

summary: Selena Quintanilla-Perez rose from her family’s Tejano band to become a crossover superstar, winning a Grammy and gaining a record contract by age 15. She was tragically murdered at 23, a loss that sent shockwaves through Latino communities and launched her music to a global English‑speaking audience. Two decades later, her legacy endures through millions of fans, a commemorative festival, and enduring influence on Tejano and pop music.
reference:
Selena's music attracted Latino fans in the U.S. and Spanish-speaking fans abroad .
She had to learn Spanish to conduct interviews in Spanish-speaking countries .
Her English-language album went to No. 1 on Billboard's Top 200 chart after she died .

summary: A memoir by Christine Lee reveals that her sister, the real Jenny Lee who inspired a character on *Call The Midwife*, was a fiery, temperamental nurse dismissed for smacking a child.  Christine argues her sister’s outbursts were fueled by a long‑standing love for an older married man and a turbulent family life, including her parents’ divorce after her mother’s stroke.  The book paints a stark contrast to the gentle TV portrayal, detailing Jenny’s early hardships, the abuse at a convent school, and her struggles to overcome dyslexia and adversity.
reference:
Jenny Lee's life was turned upside down when her parents divorced .

summary: Cahoots, a 1940‑s themed bar, opens in Soho’s former WWII air‑raid shelter, featuring a vintage tube carriage and authentic period decor. Owned by Charlie Gilkes and Duncan Stirling, the venue recreates the era with wooden staircases, period fabrics, and quirky cocktails served in clocks. Guests are welcomed by a station master and issued a “day ticket” to enjoy the nostalgic underground experience.
reference:
Soho-based Cahoots aims to transport guests back to the war period, with themed cocktails and authentic decor .
Among the delights are a cocktail drank out of a clock, staff in character, and ticket booth upon your entrance .

summary:
Deputy U.S. Marshal Josie Wells was killed in a shootout near Baton Rouge.  
His wife, optometrist Channing Wells, announced they were expecting a son who will be named Josie Wells Jr.  
The couple, married for nearly three years, had been together since college.
reference:
Wife Channing Wells said on Wednesday that the baby will be named Josie Wells Jr, after his father .
The last thing she told her husband was that she had an appointment - but not until next week - to learn whether the baby was a boy or a girl .

The suspect, Jamie Croom, 31,  was hit multiple times in the shootout. He died early on Wednesday .
Before Croom died, the U.S. Attorney's Office charged him with the young deputy's murder .

summary: The Obama administration defended the 2014 prisoner‑swap that returned deserter Sgt. Bowe Bergdahl in exchange for five Taliban leaders, with State Department spokesperson Jen Psaki and White House officials stressing the commitment to not leave troops behind. The deal has sparked bipartisan criticism, with members of Congress accusing the president of violating law and endangering national security. summary: Australia have named a 17‑man squad to defend the Ashes, with fast bowlers such as Mitchell Johnson and Ryan Harris leading the attack. summary: Nathan Ker, a 24‑year‑old construction worker, was diagnosed with a large brain tumour after months of debilitating migraines. He met his fiancée Rikki Milne just weeks before the diagnosis, and she has been his primary support through surgery and recovery. Ker credits Milne as his “other half” and plans to marry her once he’s healed.
reference:
A  New Zealand man endured eight months of excruciating migraines .
But after his CT scan, doctors said it was a form of a severe migraines .
Nathan Ker was suffering months of physical and mental pain .

He was rushed to hospital after the left side of his body was numb again .
Doctors found a large tumour on the right side of his brain after CT scans .
Luckily, he was diagnosed with miningioma, a non-cancerous tumor .
Ker is unable to work but has promised his fiance a trip back to home to NZ .
'Rikki and I are still in love and inseparable - she is my other half', he said .

summary: Mert Tanay was stopped by police after driving a BMW at over 120 mph on the M20 with his six‑year‑old son inside. He was banned from driving for three years following a court hearing, where he claimed he was distracted by thoughts of his upcoming wedding. The incident involved a ten‑mile police chase and raised concerns about the child's safety on the motorway.
reference:
Mert Tanay was driving along M20 with his six-year-old son as passenger .

summary: IRS impersonation scammers have called 10,000 Americans a week, stealing $15.5 million from 3,000 victims. One victim, Al Cadenhead, lost $16,500 after a caller instructed him to transfer funds to prepaid cards. About 366,000 people received the scam call, with roughly 1 % actually falling for it.
reference:
Treasury Department deputy inspector general for investigations Tim Camus said that the hoax is the 'largest, most pervasive impersonation scam in the history of the agency'
Scammers are calling 10,000 Americans a week posing at IRS agents and have already stolen $15.5million from 3,000 victims, say federal agents .
'Don't disregard this message as delay in calling us back might end up in a legal matter for you,' says the scam call message .
Fraudsters supposedly tell the victims to withdraw money from their accounts, buy pre-paid debit cards and tell them the number .

summary:
Jeremy Clarkson says he will return to the BBC, but may be overseen by an executive minder to keep him in line.

summary: Experts warn that anti‑drug lessons in schools may actually encourage pupils to try illegal substances. The Advisory Council on Misuse of Drugs found that prevention classes are ineffective and may raise drug‑use risk. It urged the government to cut funding unless evidence shows the initiatives work.
reference:
Experts warn anti-drugs lessons may encourage pupils to try substances .

summary: Romania fans complained that their team’s pitch was left rain‑drenched, with groundsmen using sponges to try to dry it before the Euro 2016 qualifier. reference:
Men used sponges to soak up water from Romania's rain-drenched pitch .

Jimmy Graham signed with the Seahawks, trading Max Unger and draft picks to give Russell Wilson a red‑zone option.  
Haloti Ngata left the Ravens for Detroit, while Nick Foles joined the Rams and Sam Bradford headed the opposite way.

She left behind six children, from 11‑month‑old twins to a 14‑year‑old, and had worked as a school secretary. Police are inspecting the vehicle while the family mourns the loss.

Laura Lloyd's husband backed a trailer into her Wednesday morning .

summary: A forgotten canine tooth from Peking Man was rediscovered in an unopened museum box, allowing scientists to re-examine it with modern techniques. The tooth’s wear patterns suggest it belonged to an older female who gnawed on bones and hard nuts. The find confirms Peking Man’s diet and provides new insights into this ancient human ancestor.
reference:
Tooth was found in a box at the Museum of Evolution at Uppsala University .
Fossil was found in the 1920s but has been lost for decades .
It belonged to an ancient human ancestor  some 500,000 years ago .
Peking Man is the name of the species, not an individual .
Wear and tear indicates person gnawed on bones and crunched hard nuts .
Canine tooth belonged to a woman who was quite old when she died .

summary:
Ferguson residents filed an affidavit to initiate a recall of Mayor James Knowles, aiming to gather enough signatures to trigger a referendum within 60 days.  
The effort follows the resignation of the police chief, city manager, and other officials amid a Justice Department report exposing institutional racism in the city.  
Mayor Knowles declined to step down, saying he will remain in office while the community continues to grapple with anger and frustration.

summary: Paul Ross‑Bowker, after his appendix was removed, was moved to a converted storage room at Gwynedd Hospital where he slept on an old bed with a brass bell to call for help and his IV drip hanging from a light fixture. The room, lacking an alarm system, contained oxygen cannisters and medical supplies, making his recovery difficult and causing pain and infection. Despite the poor conditions, his mother said she cannot fault the staff for caring for her son.

He was given a brass bell to call nurses and his drip was hung from a light .
Mother said she was shocked but added she couldn't praise staff enough .
Hospital said it was a treatment room used for clinical procedures .

summary: A motorcyclist failed to stop at a junction in Khabarovsk, Russia, and his bike was hit by a speeding lorry, causing it to be pulled off the road. Dash‑cam footage captures the moment the lorry’s wheels slam into the bike, launching the rider’s head violently. Despite the violent impact, the rider miraculously escaped with his life.

summary: An envelope at the White House Mail Screening Facility contained an unknown milky substance that tested presumptively positive for cyanide. The Secret Service will conduct a third round of tests to confirm the finding, while saying no injuries or exposure concerns occurred. No further comment has been provided as the investigation continues.

The mail handler suffered no injuries and there were no exposure concerns .

summary: Aaron Ramsey says Wales can surprise Belgium in the Euro 2016 qualifiers after a 3‑0 win over Israel. He celebrated his first goal in honour of his grandmother who recently died. The Welsh side will host Belgium on June 12, hoping to top the group.

Aaron Ramsey insists Wales can spring a surprise against Belgium .
Wales earned 3-0 Group B victory against Israel on Saturday night .

summary: Australian Treasurer Joe Hockey testified that a Fairfax Media article titled “Treasurer for Sale” caused distress to his family, with his elderly father breaking down in tears. He claimed the headline led his wife and children to question him, and his daughter asked if someone was trying to buy him. Hockey is suing Fairfax for defamation over the story that covered a political fundraising body in his electorate.

The court action centres on stories run by Fairfax Media under the headline 'Treasurer for sale'
Mr Hockey claims that there was a  'clear allegation of corruption' within the North Sydney Forum, a political fundraising party in his electorate .

summary: Tyaina Finch, the girlfriend of off‑duty Darby Borough patrolman Mark Hudson, has been charged with murder after he was shot at their home. She first claimed the fatal shooting happened accidentally while retrieving his duty gun from their dog’s mouth, but police found her statements inconsistent. The case follows a tumultuous relationship and prior domestic‑disturbance calls, and a vigil and funeral arrangements have been held for the officer.

The girlfriend of an off-duty Pennsylvania police officer who was shot and killed over the weekend is in custody .

summary: Global warming threatens the taste and texture of staple foods: beef will become tougher, carrots and potatoes will lose flavor, and shellfish may taste sour due to ocean acidification. Rising temperatures also shrink onion size, reduce fruit, nut, and grain yields, and lower dairy protein, impacting cheese quality. Overall, climate change could make classic barbecue ingredients less appetizing and disrupt food supply chains.
reference:
Report by University of Melbourne warns that many foods are under threat .
It says that heatwaves will cause livestock like cattle to suffer heat stress .
Beef and pork likely to become tougher while chicken will become stringer .
Onions and beetroot crops are likely to produce smaller sized vegetables .
Carrots will lose  their distinctive flavour and take on an unpleasant texture .
Milk yields can decrease by 10-25 per cent during heat waves, report warns .
Protein levels in milk may also fall meaning cheese will decline in quality .

summary: Elite Singles surveyed 28,000 Australian singles and ranked Sydney as the most attractive city, followed by Melbourne and the Gold Coast. Other top cities include Brisbane, Perth, Sunshine Coast, Adelaide, Canberra, Newcastle and Coffs Harbour. In Sydney, the inner‑west suburb Balmain topped the list, with Lane Cove and Manly close behind.
reference:
Dating website Elite Singles surveyed 28,000 single Australians .
Participants aged 30-55 were asked to rate their level of attractiveness .
Sydneysiders claim they are the sexiest, with Melbourne and Gold Coast ranking in at second and third .
Darwin and Hobart prove more modest, sinking well below the top ten .

Prosecutors say he secretly filmed dozens of students in his classroom bathroom using a spy camera and stored the footage on his personal computer. He now faces 25 felony charges that could add up to 184 years in prison.

summary: Islamist extremism has surged across North and sub‑Saharan Africa, striking sites like Tunisia’s Bardo Museum and the In Amenas gas plant in Algeria, and targeting foreigners and government facilities. High‑profile attacks have involved Al Qaeda‑in‑the Islamic Maghreb and ISIS affiliates in Libya, Mali, and beyond. In response, the U.S. has set up a military command and base in Djibouti, France has intervened in Mali, and Western militaries are training local special forces to counter the growing threat.

summary: Eltham Palace, once Henry VIII’s childhood home, was transformed in the 1930s by the wealthy Courtauld family into an Art Deco retreat. The palace is scheduled to reopen to the public on 3 April, offering visitors a glimpse of its glamorous 1930s atmosphere.

He won gold in the 60 m at the 2014 World Indoor Championships and the 2015 European Indoors, earning a multi‑year Nike contract and large prize money.

The incident was reported to police by a concerned family friend during a disturbance at his estranged wife’s home. Authorities have charged him with endangering the child.

Andreas Lubitz, 27, captured on an in-flight camera taking off  in a glider .

summary: The 2008 Los Angeles fast‑food ordinance banned new standalone restaurants in South Los Angeles but did not curb obesity, which rose 12 % in the targeted area. Researchers found that most new food outlets—17 fast‑food chains and many convenience stores—opened in strip malls and food courts, which were exempt from the ban. The study concluded the ordinance had little measurable effect on diets or obesity rates, though soft‑drink consumption fell citywide.
